sets.ref: hand: 60 W incandescent bulb for 1000 h at 0.12 per kWh: E = 60 W x 1 h x 1000 = 60 kWh = 60 x 3.6e6 = 2.16e8 J; cost = 60 x 0.12 = 7.20
hand: 15 W lamp for 1000 h at 0.12 per kWh: E = 15 kWh = 5.4e7 J; cost = 15 x 0.12 = 1.80
hand: 100 W bulb, 3 h a day, 365 days at 0.10 per kWh: E = 100 x 3 x 365 / 1000 = 109.5 kWh = 3.942e8 J; cost = 109.5 x 0.10 = 10.95
hand: 20 W LED, 3 h a day, 365 days at 0.10 per kWh: E = 20 x 3 x 365 / 1000 = 21.9 kWh = 7.884e7 J; cost = 2.19
hand: Virginia Cooperative Extension publication 2901-9014, window fan: (200 W x 4 h/day x 120 days) / 1000 = 96 kWh = 3.456e8 J; cost = 96 x 0.085 = 8.16

hand: Virginia Cooperative Extension publication 2901-9014, PC and monitor (120 W + 150 W = 270 W, 4 h/day, 365 days): E = 270 x 4 x 365 / 1000 = 394.2 kWh = 1.41912e9 J; cost = 394.2 x 0.085 = 33.507 (the publication prints 33.51)
hand: the defaults, 100 W, 3 h a day, 365 days at 0.30 per kWh: E = 109.5 kWh = 3.942e8 J; cost = 109.5 x 0.30 = 32.85; check in joules 100 W x 10800 s x 365 = 3.942e8 J
hand: 2 kW heater, 1.5 h a day, 30 days at 0.35 per kWh: E = 2000 x 1.5 x 30 / 1000 = 90 kWh = 3.24e8 J; cost = 90 x 0.35 = 31.50

hand: a cost of 32.85 at 0.30 per kWh is E = 32.85 / 0.3 = 109.5 kWh = 3.942e8 J; hours per day 3.942e8 / (100 x 365) = 10800 s = 3 h
hand: 30 h a day is impossible (the check fires): E = 100 x 108000 x 365 = 3.942e9 J
hand: a negative power fires the check: E = -100 x 10800 x 365 = -3.942e8 J and the cost -109.5 x 0.3 is negative, which the number dimension refuses (range)
